apps.name: Home
apps.localizedDescription: Personal tools in one app: Cầu lông, Chia kèo, Nhật ký, Monitor and Koma.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Chia kèo: tạo cuộc chơi, thêm người, khoản chi, ghi nhận trả nợ ngay trong app
- Chia kèo: Ảnh tổng kết có xem trước, chọn nền, bật/tắt QR và avatar, Copy ảnh
- Chia kèo: lịch sử có hoàn tác, ảnh, link chia sẻ, danh bạ, kho cầu, thống kê
- Patch release to test SideStore updates. No user-facing changes.

- New Nhật ký tool: browse notes by month and day, write notes with mood, tags and photos, album, year summary, trash.
- New Monitor tool: Odoo cron monitor with late crons, instance editing and alert delay.
- New Koma tool: frame-by-frame video review for badminton swings.

- New Chia kèo tool: games, who pays whom, add an expense with receipt scan.
- One Google sign-in in Cài đặt for every tool.

- App icon now shows on iPhone.
- Links open in the browser.

- First release: Cầu lông tool shows free badminton courts and notifies new free slots.
- Sign in with Google or a QR code.

apps.name: Zalo Viewer
apps.localizedDescription: Read your synced Zalo chats and photos on iPhone, also offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Reads chats from the cloud: chat list and messages, photos, works offline with the last cached data.
- Shows the last sync time.
- Back button on the cloud setup screen.
- Fix: app works when opened from the Dock; sync no longer re-sends old messages.
- First release: read synced Zalo chats.
